prompt:
Create a revised Custra UI mockup board showing FOUR mobile screens side by side. The first reference is the existing pastel Custra board: preserve its muted sage, warm ivory, mist blue, dark readable slate, minimal line icons and folded-C logo structure. References 2 and 3 specify the calendar popover and three-column time-grid STRUCTURE only, not green colors. Follow this user change: preferred date and time are picked within the initial complaint form, using compact popup pickers. No full-screen appointment wizard, no 1-of-2 step headers. Also fix the duplicate active-complaint entry point on product detail. High-resolution straight-on flat screen designs, 390x844 equivalent proportions, readable text, small outer captions Product details, Lean complaint form, Date picker, Time picker. No heavy phone hardware, no unnecessary explanatory banners, no giant empty hero regions. Show fictional data only.

SCREEN 1 Product details: compact back arrow/header, small Custra logo, Edit link. TV icon, nickname Living room TV, Samsung · Television, muted sage text pill Under warranty, small 'Based on saved details'. ONE and ONLY ONE Current complaint section below identity: Screen won’t turn on; '#DEMO-1042 · Awaiting appointment'; action 'View complaint →'. REMOVE entirely the standalone top View ongoing complaint button. Below this section a modest secondary '+ Report another issue'. Then flat product information rows Purchase date 20 Oct 2025, Warranty period 24 months, Warranty until 20 Oct 2027. Documents section with Purchase invoice.pdf and View, + Add document. Collapsed Past complaints row. Bottom Home Products Appointments with Products active. No repeated complaint card or duplicate action.

SCREEN 2 Lean complaint form: compact back arrow, Custra logo, heading 'Register complaint'. One compact product row fridge icon Kitchen fridge, Samsung · Refrigerator, Change. Label 'What’s wrong?' and ONE moderately sized textarea with fictional text 'The fridge is not cooling properly.' No separate summary field. Below textarea FOUR VERY SLIM full-width rows, each about 52–60 CSS px high with small left icon, concise label, compact saved value, right chevron or edit affordance; thin neutral rules, no big cards:
'Service address' / 'Home · Pune'
'Phone number' / '••••••1234'
'Preferred date' / 'Tue, 20 Oct 2026'
'Preferred time' / '11 AM–12 PM IST'
Each label/value pair may use two closely spaced text lines if needed. NO name or email displayed, NO separate tall contact section, NO address paragraph, no info banner. Small quiet line below rows 'Preferred slot, subject to confirmation.' Large muted sage 'Register complaint' button with dark label. Bottom nav Home Products Appointments, Home active. Small 'Demo support' text only if space. Form is lean and within one viewport, not spread out to fill height.

SCREEN 3 Date picker: show the SAME lean complaint form behind a compact white/ivory CALENDAR POPOVER anchored directly above its Preferred date row, like the user's screenshot. Background remains recognizable with slight subdued treatment, not blacked out. Popover has month/year header October 2026 and previous/next arrows, weekday labels Sun Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat, a correct seven-column calendar. Oct 1 2026 is Thursday; date rows are blanks through Wed then 1,2,3; 4-10; 11-17; 18-24; 25-31. Always keep ALL date numerals visible, including unavailable 21. 20 is selected with muted sage circle and dark label. Past dates disabled in readable grey. Demo offered dates 19,20,22,23 selectable with tiny sage dot; 21 unavailable readable grey, other non-offered dates disabled. Quiet one-line legend 'Demo availability'. No oversized header, no product card inside popover, no full-screen wizard. Select date returns to the form; no booking confirmation on this calendar. Under popover the Preferred date row clearly shows Tue,20 Oct, and Preferred time row still present.

SCREEN 4 Time picker: show the SAME form lightly subdued behind a small centered rounded modal matching the user's reference structure. Dialog title 'Preferred time · 20 Oct' and an always-visible 'Change date' text action. Nine COMPACT time tiles arranged EXACTLY THREE COLUMNS by THREE ROWS:
9–10 AM (available), 10–11 AM (disabled, Unavailable), 11 AM–12 PM (selected pale sage, dark label and tick);
12–1 PM (available), 1–2 PM (available), 2–3 PM (disabled, Unavailable);
3–4 PM (available), 4–5 PM (disabled, Unavailable), 5–6 PM (available).
Time labels may wrap to two lines for legibility. Available tile backgrounds ivory with thin neutral border. Disabled grey but readable with explicit Unavailable text. Bottom of dialog: Cancel left, muted sage 'Save preference' right. Small 'IST · Demo availability' line. This saves a preference to form; DO NOT label Confirm appointment because no appointment is booked yet. Change date returns to date picker while preserving complaint text, phone and address. The selected preferred slot is later reconfirmed against business availability; do not show a booking-success state here.

Keep all four screens highly consistent and minimal. The two popup states should visibly correspond to the same initial lean form, not standalone appointment pages. Preserve original Custra emblem shape while using approved soft sage/teal colors. Do not introduce saturated blue or green.
notes: User requested initial-form preferred date/time and slim address/phone rows; this supersedes earlier no-upfront-preference design.
Preference is not confirmed appointment; recheck actual availability and obtain explicit booking confirmation after agent registration.
Phone-only visible summary does not authorize removing name/email from existing profile/agent data.
Generated layout accidentally highlights unavailable calendar date 21 faintly; only the selected date should have selection styling in implementation.
Corrected product detail has one active-complaint section.
